summary: Project notice delivery only from receipts authorized at their authenticated owner positions.

replay.detail: Receipt projection checks the durable historical acknowledgement chain and authenticated causal position, preserving valid evidence across later graph withdrawal and replay.

schema.detail: The projection consumes the existing immutable receipt and owner acknowledgement contracts.

rules.detail: A wrong signer, missing signature, forked acknowledgement chain, or receipt outside the active owner interval yields unknown delivery. Completion timestamps and current runtime designation do not establish authority.

compatibility.detail: Unsigned and actor-asserted legacy receipts do not become delivery evidence. Generic reserved reads remain denied.

manual.detail: Projection itself performs no delivery or recipient action.

recovery.detail: Restore missing causal prerequisites and retry admission. Unknown delivery is not permission to resend.
